exclusions.source_text: Any active malignancy in the past 2 years prior to C1D1, with the exception of non-melanoma skin cancer, or cervical carcinoma in situ or breast carcinoma in situ that has been excised or resected completely and is without evidence of local recurrence or metastasis.
ALT (SGPT) and AST (SGOT) ≤ 2.5x upper limit of normal (ULN),
Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected participants on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months of C1D1 are eligible for this trial.

Participants with known history or current symptoms of cardiac disease, or history of treatment with cardiotoxic agents, should have a clinical risk assessment of cardiac function using the New York Heart Association Functional Classification. To be eligible for this trial, participants should be class 2B or better.
women of child-bearing potential and men must agree to use adequate contraception
